name: galestream-insight-look-six-decline-bottoms-all-six
notes: Galestream Insight (usa6qyq3ka): declining the optional Spell reveal (MZMAYCHOOSE answered PASS) must still put all six looked-at cards on the bottom of the deck in their original order, nothing into memory. Same dontSkipOnPass defect as Eventide Lure/Foraging Fox: GalestreamInsightReveal was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so on PASS the handler was skipped and the six cards stayed stranded in myTempZone (deck 7 instead of 13).

rulesClauses: You may reveal a Spell card from among them ... (declined) Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. GalestreamInsightResolve() pulled the top six cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"). Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot every iteration after the first and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped: only the top card was looked at (live repro on HEAD: Spell candidates deeper in the top six never offered, deck stayed 13). Fix: pull the six cards with array_shift() on the live deck (same shape as EventideLureEnter/Glimpse). Second defect found while proving it: GalestreamInsightReveal was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the optional reveal skipped the handler and stranded the six looked-at cards in myTempZone (deck 7 instead of 13); fixed with dontSkipOnPass:1.
